results.name: Horizontal Leg Press Calf Raise Single Leg
instructions: Sit on the leg press and place the ball of one foot on the bottom edge of the platform.
Extend the leg with a soft knee bend.
Push the platform away by pointing your toes.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch legs.
tips: Use a lighter weight than with two legs.
Pause at the top.
results.description: Horizontal Leg Press Calf Raise Single Leg is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Horizontal Leg Press Calf Raise
instructions: Sit on the leg press and place the balls of your feet on the bottom edge of the platform.
Extend your legs with a soft knee bend.
Push the platform away by pointing your toes.
Let your heels come back for a stretch and repeat.
tips: Keep your knees still.
Use a full range of motion.
results.description: Horizontal Leg Press Calf Raise is a beginner single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category.

results.name: Horizontal Leg Press Single Leg
instructions: Sit on the leg press and place one foot in the centre of the platform.
Bend the knee to bring the weight toward you.
Lower until your knee is at about 90 degrees.
Press back out without locking the knee, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Use a light weight to begin.
results.description: Horizontal Leg Press Single Leg is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hamstrings.

results.name: Horizontal Leg Press
instructions: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet hip-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety and bend your knees to bring the weight toward you.
Lower until your knees are about 90 degrees.
Press through your feet to extend your legs without locking them, and repeat.
tips: Keep your lower back on the pad.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.
results.description: Horizontal Leg Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with a leverage machine, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Glutes, Hamstrings.

results.name: In and Out Squats
instructions: Stand tall with your back straight, feet shoulder-width apart, and clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Lower your hips, jump up and land into a squat position with your knees bent, thighs parallel to the floor, and feet placed wider than your shoulder width.
Then lower your hips again, jump up, and land into a squat position with your knees bent, thighs parallel to the floor, and feet placed hip-width apart this time.
Repeat by jumping in and out alternately.
tips: Land softly on your forefeet to reduce impact on your joints.
Ensure your knees are aligned with your toes when you squat to avoid strain.
Move quickly but with control to maximize the effectiveness of the exercise and prevent injury.
results.description: In and Out Squats is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves.

results.name: Jumping Lunge
instructions: Stand in a split stance with one foot forward and clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Bend both knees and lower into a lunge until your back knee is just above the floor.
Jump straight upward, switch your legs in the air, and land with the opposite foot forward.
Lower into the next lunge and continue alternating sides.
tips: Keep your torso upright throughout the movement.
Lower your back knee toward the floor without touching it.
Land softly and bend both knees to absorb the impact.
Exhale as you jump and inhale as you lower into the lunge.
results.description: Jumping Lunge is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Calves, Core.

results.name: Jumping Pistol Squat
instructions: Stand on one leg with your hands on your hips and extend your opposite leg slightly forward.
Bend your supporting knee and lower into a single-leg squat while keeping your opposite leg extended in front of you.
Push forcefully through your supporting foot and jump straight upward.
Land softly on the same leg, lower into the next squat, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions then switch sides.
tips: Keep your extended leg off the floor throughout the movement.
Land softly and bend your knee to absorb the impact.
Maintain an upright chest as you lower.
Inhale as you lower and exhale as you jump.
results.description: Jumping Pistol Squat is an advanced multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the plyometric category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Hip Flexors, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Calf Raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a kettlebell in each hand by your sides.
Press through the balls of your feet and raise both heels as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top while keeping your legs straight and your body upright.
Lower your heels to the floor with control, then repeat.
tips: Keep your knees straight without locking them.
Raise your heels without leaning forward.
Lower your heels slowly through the full range of motion.
Exhale as you rise and inhale as you lower.
results.description: Kettlebell Calf Raise is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the calves (lower legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Kettlebell Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor. Hold a kettlebell securely across your hips with both hands.
Press through your feet and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Continue lifting until your body forms a straight line from your shoulders to your knees, holding at the top.
Lower your hips back to the floor with control, then repeat.
tips: Press through your heels and midfoot as you lift your hips.
Keep your hips level without rotating to either side.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without arching your lower back.
Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Kettlebell Glute Bridge is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Adductors, Core.

results.name: Kettlebell Hip Thrust With Bench
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back resting against the edge of a bench, your knees bent, and your feet flat on the floor. Hold a kettlebell securely across your hips with both hands.
Press through your feet and lift your hips upward while keeping your upper back supported on the bench.
Continue lifting until your torso and thighs form a straight line, then squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower your hips with control to the starting position, then repeat.
tips: Keep your upper back firmly supported on the bench throughout the movement.
Press through your heels and midfoot as you lift.
Fully extend your hips without arching your lower back.
Exhale as you lift your hips and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Kettlebell Hip Thrust With Bench is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the glutes (upper legs). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Hamstrings, Core.
